artifacts.title: Applicability of BCO 10-3 sermon and moderator-absence procedures to presbyteries

matches.evidence: The CCB advised that BCO 10-3 is ambiguous on moderator absence, leaving each presbytery to interpret it, and ruled that telephone conference meetings are impermissible.

artifacts.title: Whether a ruling elder moderator must also hold a representative commission

matches.evidence: The CCB advised that a non-representative ruling elder may serve as presbytery moderator, but may only vote when his vote would be determinative.
